meta_rows: Word list used for test 2 - hearing aid formula condition - word in noise - Insight46 phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 word in noise. High-frequency monosyllabic words are presented against background noise, and the sound level of each word is varied, to obtain a "speech reception threshold" which represents the ability of the participant to identify words in background noise . Not collected at phase 2.
